title: inbox-preview
description: Render HTML/.eml emails in real Gmail, Outlook & Yahoo web clients and screenshot them
summary: Render HTML/.eml emails in real Gmail, Outlook & Yahoo web clients and screenshot them
offersHint: Render HTML/.eml emails in real Gmail, Outlook & Yahoo web clients and screenshot them · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.powerline.ai/v1/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_clients
toolsPreview.description: List the email clients this deployment can render right now, with their rendering tier, engine, and capabilities

toolsPreview.name: submit_preview
toolsPreview.description: Submit an email for rendering across email clients — full HTML, or a complete raw .eml (base64). Provide exactly one of html/eml. Returns a job ID to poll for results.

toolsPreview.name: get_job
toolsPreview.description: Get the status and screenshots for a preview job. Poll until status is "completed".

toolsPreview.name: get_screenshot
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a rendered screenshot. Returns the image URL for the given job, client, width, and environment (color scheme / images).
